attributes.文字转写: How do we measure the impact of a film? Some measure it by its box office, but for me, the true impact of a film can be as simple as a memorable line or a searing performance. attributes.文字转写: As a shy little girl, a daughter of immigrant parents, animated films introduced me to worlds beyond my home and my classroom.

attributes.重音与强调: 强调'shy little girl', 'immigrant parents', 'animated films'
attributes.说话人意图: 分享个人经历，建立情感联系
attributes.潜台词: 动画电影对我的人生有深远影响
attributes.caption: 一位女性以真诚且略带感性的语气，讲述自己作为移民女儿，如何通过动画电影探索更广阔的世界。

attributes.文字转写: Then, as I got older, I began to realize that those films contained some of the most sophisticated storytelling in all of cinema.
attributes.说话人意图: 表达对动画电影艺术价值的认可
attributes.潜台词: 动画电影是重要的艺术形式
attributes.修辞策略: 对比（小时候 vs 长大后）
attributes.声音功能: 深化主题，提升动画电影的地位
attributes.caption: 她继续说道，随着年龄增长，她开始认识到这些电影包含了整个电影史上最精妙的叙事。

attributes.文字转写: Their impact is extraordinary, and I can't wait to introduce my daughter to this world now, knowing it will take her imagination in directions that no one's even dreamed up yet.
attributes.说话人意图: 分享将这份热爱传递给下一代的愿望
attributes.潜台词: 动画电影的力量可以超越时代
attributes.声音功能: 将个人情感与更宏大的主题（想象力）联系起来
attributes.caption: 她表达了这些电影的非凡影响力，并迫不及待地想将自己的女儿带入这个世界，相信这会激发她前所未有的想象力。

attributes.文字转写: Let's take a look at this year's nominees for Best Animated Feature Film.
attributes.重音与强调: 强调'this year's nominees', 'Best Animated Feature Film'
attributes.说话人意图: 引出颁奖典礼的核心环节
attributes.声音功能: 过渡，从个人叙述转向正式流程
attributes.caption: 她引导观众一同关注今年的最佳动画长片提名名单。

attributes.文字转写: I Lost My Body, Jeremy Clapin, and Barbara de Feraud.
attributes.停顿分布: 在每个名字后有短暂停顿
attributes.重音与强调: 强调每个提名者的名字
attributes.caption: 接着是《我失去了身体》(I Lost My Body) 及其制作人 Jeremy Clapin 和 Barbara de Feraud。

attributes.文字转写: Close.
attributes.caption: 然后是《亲密》(Close)。

attributes.文字转写: Jinko Goto and Marisa Roman.

attributes.重音与强调: 强调每个提名者的名字
attributes.caption: 以及其制作人 Jinko Goto 和 Marisa Roman。

attributes.caption: 最后是《玩具总动员4》(Toy Story 4) 及其制作人 Josh Cooley, Martin Nielsen, 和 Jonas Rivera。

attributes.主旋律: 无明显主旋律，以和声为主
attributes.声音功能: 烘托气氛，增强情感表达
attributes.caption: 一段贯穿始终的、由合成器和弦乐构成的温馨背景音乐，营造出梦幻而充满希望的氛围。

attributes.文字转写: And the Oscar goes to Toy Story 4.
attributes.caption: 一位女主持人用兴奋的语气宣布《玩具总动员4》获得奥斯卡奖。
现场爆发出热烈的掌声和欢呼声。

attributes.文字转写: This is the first Oscar and nomination for Mark Fieldman. The first Oscar and second nomination for Josh Cooley. The second Oscar and third nomination for Jonas Rivera.
attributes.命名实体: Mark Fieldman, Josh Cooley, Jonas Rivera
attributes.caption: 主持人继续介绍几位获奖者的过往提名和获奖记录。

attributes.主旋律: 上行音阶
attributes.caption: 响起一段喜庆的管弦乐，以铜管和打击乐为主，营造出胜利和庆祝的氛围。

attributes.文字转写: We are so, so grateful for this honor.
attributes.caption: 一位男性获奖者上台，真诚地表达了对这份荣誉的感激之情。

attributes.文字转写: Uh, we just want on behalf of the incredible cast and our crew up at Pixar Animation Studios, we just want to thank the Academy uh for honoring our film alongside so many beautiful animated films this year. We're just proud to be among them.
attributes.重音与强调: incredible cast, Pixar Animation Studios, beautiful animated films
attributes.潜台词: 肯定团队的努力和同行作品的优秀
attributes.caption: 获奖者代表演员和皮克斯动画工作室的团队，感谢学院将他们的电影与众多优秀的动画电影一同表彰，并为此感到自豪。

attributes.文字转写: Listen, uh, we take great pride in the fact that we get to make family films. And uh Toy Story 4 is really a love letter to our families.
attributes.重音与强调: great pride, family films, love letter
attributes.潜台词: 电影承载了对家庭的爱
attributes.caption: 获奖者表示，他们为能制作家庭电影而感到自豪，并说《玩具总动员4》是对家人们的一封情书。

attributes.文字转写: This is for our parents, this is for our wives, this is for our kids. We love you.
attributes.caption: 获奖者将奖项献给父母、妻子和孩子，并向他们表达爱意。

attributes.文字转写: We want to thank the movie-going audience so much, especially those that grew up with Toy Story.
attributes.重音与强调: thank, movie-going audience, grew up with Toy Story
attributes.潜台词: 观众的支持是电影成功的基础
attributes.caption: 获奖者感谢广大观众，特别是那些伴随着《玩具总动员》系列成长起来的观众。

attributes.文字转写: Um, we hope that your adventures with Woody and Buzz made growing up a little bit easier.
attributes.重音与强调: adventures, Woody and Buzz, growing up, easier
attributes.潜台词: 电影陪伴了观众的成长
attributes.caption: 获奖者希望观众与胡迪和巴斯光年的冒险经历能让他们的成长过程变得更容易一些。

attributes.文字转写: My wife, I love you so much.
attributes.caption: 获奖者特别向他的妻子表达了深深的爱意。

attributes.文字转写: Thank you.
attributes.caption: 获奖者以一句“谢谢”结束了他的获奖感言。
现场响起热烈的掌声。

attributes.文字转写: And now, here are the nominees for Best Animated Short Film.
attributes.caption: 主持人宣布最佳动画短片奖的提名名单即将公布。

attributes.caption: 主持人继续宣读《Hair Love》的另一位制作人Karen Rupert Toliver。

attributes.caption: 主持人宣读第三部提名作品《Kitbull》及其制作人Rosanna Sullivan和Kathryn Hendrickson。

attributes.caption: 主持人激动地宣布《Hair Love》获得奥斯卡奖。
现场爆发出雷鸣般的掌声和欢呼声，庆祝《Hair Love》获奖。

attributes.文字转写: This is the first Oscar and nomination for Matthew A. Cherry and Karen Rupert Toliver.
attributes.caption: 主持人宣布这是马修·A·切里和凯伦·鲁珀特·托利弗首次获得奥斯卡提名。

attributes.主旋律: 由铜管和弦乐共同奏出
attributes.caption: 响起一段宏大、喜庆的管弦乐，作为颁奖典礼的背景音乐。
现场观众报以热烈的掌声。

attributes.文字转写: Thank you so much to the Academy and everybody out there that supported this film. There were lots of you that we share this award with you. There were so many filmmakers that worked so hard on this, and it was a labor of love. And it was because we have a firm belief that representation matters deeply.
attributes.重音与强调: labor of love, representation matters deeply
attributes.说话人意图: 表达感谢和阐述获奖理念
attributes.潜台词: 强调多样性和代表性的重要性
attributes.caption: 获奖者发表感言，感谢学院和支持者，并强调“代表性至关重要”的信念。
观众再次报以热烈的掌声，表示对获奖者言论的强烈共鸣。

attributes.文字转写: Especially, especially in cartoons. Because in cartoons, that's when we first see our movies and it's how we shape our lives and think about how we see the world. So I want to thank Sony Pictures Animation, who are the progressive people that believed in us from the beginning. Christine Belson, Jeff Corchak. Um, thank you to Lion Forge Animation, to Six Point Harness, and to Matthew Cherry. Thank you to my my beautiful husband, my son Chase and Miles, for believing in me. Thank you so much.
attributes.说话人意图: 具体感谢各方支持和家人
attributes.潜台词: 表达对家人支持的深切感激
attributes.caption: 获奖者继续感谢索尼动画等公司以及她的丈夫和儿子，言语中充满真情实感。
演讲结束后，现场响起长时间的热烈掌声。

attributes.文字转写: We we have a big team that we have to thank but time is running short so I just want to say that Hair Love was done because we wanted to see more representation in animation. We wanted to normalize black hair. There's a very important issue that's out there, it's the CROWN Act, and if we can help to get this passed in all 50 states it will help stories like DeAndre Arnold's who's our special guest tonight stop to happen.
attributes.音高语调: 总体平稳，结尾处略微上扬
attributes.说话人意图: 表达感谢、阐述创作动机、倡导社会变革
attributes.潜台词: 希望作品能带来积极的社会影响
attributes.文化语境: 美国社会关于种族和发型的讨论
attributes.caption: 一位男性获奖者在颁奖典礼上发表感言，他感谢了团队，并阐述了其作品《头发之爱》旨在增加动画中的代表性、使黑人头发正常化。他还提到了“CROWN法案”，并希望该法案能在所有州通过，以帮助像DeAndre Arnold这样的故事不再发生。
现场观众报以热烈的掌声。

attributes.文字转写: This award is dedicated to Kobe Bryant. May we all have a second act as great as his was.
attributes.caption: 该获奖者将奖项献给科比·布莱恩特，并祝愿大家都能拥有像他一样伟大的第二幕人生。
现场观众再次报以热烈的掌声。

attributes.caption: 基努·里维斯回应说她当时非常棒。

attributes.文字转写: You were amazing.

attributes.文字转写: You were amazing.

attributes.文字转写: Thanks.

attributes.caption: 基努·里维斯表示永远不会忘记南希·迈耶斯的剧本。

attributes.文字转写: Yeah. Yeah, no, yeah.

attributes.文字转写: It was a good time.

attributes.caption: 基努·里维斯笑着重复说那确实是一段美好的时光。

attributes.文字转写: So powerful. So much that was surprising.

attributes.caption: 基努·里维斯总结说，电影非常有力，有很多令人惊讶之处。

attributes.潜台词: 对观众的掌声表示感谢
attributes.caption: 奉俊昊用英语再次致谢。

attributes.文字转写: 일단, 예, 제가 학교에서 마티의 영화를 보면서 공부했던 그런 사람인데, 같이 후배가 오른 것만도 너무 영광인데, 상을 받을 줄 전혀 몰랐었고요.
attributes.重音与强调: 영광 (荣耀), 상을 받을 줄 전혀 몰랐어요 (完全没想到会获奖)
attributes.潜台词: 对获奖感到意外和荣幸
attributes.caption: 奉俊昊用韩语表达自己作为马蒂的粉丝，能与后辈一同获奖已是荣幸，完全没想到自己会获奖。

attributes.文字转写: When I was in school, I studied Martin Scorsese's film.
attributes.潜台词: 表达对马丁·斯科塞斯的敬仰
attributes.caption: 奉俊昊用英语讲述自己在学校时研究过马丁·斯科塞斯的电影。

attributes.文字转写: It was a huge honor. I never thought I would win.
attributes.潜台词: 再次强调获奖的意外和荣幸
attributes.caption: 奉俊昊用英语总结，称获奖是巨大的荣誉，并再次表示自己从未想过会赢。

attributes.文字转写: 그 저의 영화를 아직 그 미국의 관객들이나 사람들이 모를 때 항상 제 영화를 어 리스트에 뽑고 좋아할 거 같던 우리 퀸틴 형님이 계신데 정말 사랑합니다.
attributes.重音与强调: 퀸틴 형님 (昆汀前辈), 정말 사랑합니다 (非常爱您)
attributes.潜台词: 感谢昆汀·塔伦蒂诺的支持
attributes.caption: 奉俊昊用韩语向昆汀·塔伦蒂诺表达敬意和感谢，称其在自己不被美国观众认识时就一直支持自己的电影。

attributes.文字转写: When people in the US were not familiar with my film, Quentin always put my films on his list. He's here. Thank you so much.
attributes.caption: 奉俊昊用英语再次感谢昆汀·塔伦蒂诺的支持，并指出他就在现场。

attributes.文字转写: Quentin, I love you.
attributes.caption: 奉俊昊用英语直接向昆汀·塔伦蒂诺表达爱意。
现场观众持续鼓掌。

attributes.文字转写: 그리고 같이 후배로 our Todd나 Sam이나 다 제가 너무나 존경하는 멋진 감독들인데, 예, 이 트로피를 정말 오스카 측에서 허락한다면, 텍사스 전기 톱을 이렇게 다섯 개로 잘라서 나누고 싶은 마음입니다.
attributes.命名实体: Todd, Sam, 오스카 (Oscar), 텍사스 전기 톱 (Texas Chainsaw)
attributes.重音与强调: 존경하는 멋진 감독들 (令人尊敬的优秀导演们), 오스카 측에서 허락한다면 (如果奥斯卡方面允许的话), TEXAS 전기 톱을 이렇게 다섯 개로 잘라서 나누고 싶은 마음입니다 (想把电锯切成五块分给大家)
attributes.caption: 奉俊昊用韩语幽默地表示，如果奥斯卡方面允许，他想把奖杯像电锯一样切成五块，分给包括Todd和Sam在内的其他他非常尊敬的导演们。

attributes.文字转写: And Todd and Sam, great directors that I admire. If the Academy allows, I would like to get a Texas Chainsaw, split the Oscar trophy into five and share it with all of you.
attributes.命名实体: Todd, Sam, Academy, Texas Chainsaw, Oscar
attributes.caption: 一位女性获奖者在台上发表获奖感言，语气兴奋且带有幽默感。
现场观众爆发出热烈的掌声。

attributes.文字转写: Thank you. I I will drink until next morning.
attributes.caption: 一位带有东亚口音的男性获奖者发表简短的感谢致辞。
现场观众再次报以热烈的掌声。

attributes.文字转写: Please welcome three-time Academy Award winner and recipient of the Academy's Samuel Goldwyn Award, Steven Spielberg.
attributes.命名实体: Academy Award, Samuel Goldwyn Award, Steven Spielberg
attributes.caption: 一位女性主持人用正式而热情的语气介绍著名导演史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格。
现场观众为斯皮尔伯格的登场报以长时间的热烈掌声。

attributes.文字转写: Good evening. As we celebrate the artistic highlights of the past year...
attributes.caption: 一位男性主持人以庄重的语气开始他的演讲，庆祝过去一年的艺术成就。
现场观众持续鼓掌。

attributes.文字转写: Welcome back.
attributes.caption: 主持人简短地欢迎观众回来。

attributes.文字转写: I'm George MacKay and I'm hanging up here in the balcony. Is everyone having a good time?
attributes.caption: 主持人乔治·麦凯以轻松的语气开场，询问观众是否玩得开心。
观众报以热烈的掌声和欢呼声。

attributes.文字转写: Well, we're coming to the final three awards of the evening and time is of the essence, which is why I'm here to introduce myself before introducing someone else who will in turn introduce someone else.
attributes.重音与强调: final three awards, time is of the essence
attributes.caption: 主持人解释由于时间紧迫，他将先自我介绍，然后再介绍下一位嘉宾。
观众再次鼓掌。

attributes.文字转写: Winning an Oscar ages you.
attributes.caption: 嘉宾奥利维亚·科尔曼以一句关于获得奥斯卡奖会让人变老的玩笑话开场。

attributes.文字转写: Um, hello there. Um, thank you for having me back. It's such a pleasure to be here.
attributes.caption: 嘉宾向观众问好，并感谢再次受邀参加。

attributes.文字转写: Last year was the best night of my husband's life.
attributes.caption: 嘉宾提到去年是她丈夫生命中最美好的夜晚。
观众为嘉宾的分享报以掌声。

attributes.文字转写: He he actually said that.
attributes.caption: 嘉宾开玩笑地补充说，她丈夫确实这么说过。

attributes.文字转写: And I've given birth three times.
attributes.caption: 嘉宾接着说自己已经生了三次孩子。

attributes.文字转写: Um...
attributes.caption: 嘉宾用填充词“Um”作为过渡，准备继续发言。

attributes.文字转写: So I hope you're all having as good a time as he did.
attributes.caption: 女主持人以友好的语气开始讲话，希望观众玩得开心。
观众因主持人的话而发出笑声。

attributes.文字转写: And as I did. But um, I don't want to keep you from the bar, um, uh, much longer.
attributes.潜台词: 暗示自己也想离开去酒吧
attributes.文化语境: 西方社交场合（如派对、活动）
attributes.caption: 一位女主持人用轻松的语气开玩笑说，她不想让大家再在酒吧外面待太久了。

attributes.文字转写: I know I'm supposed to talk about acting and find some clever thread connecting these performances, but their beauty and brilliance surely lies in the fact that there isn't one.
attributes.潜台词: 这些表演的价值在于其独立性和独特性，而非一个统一的线索。
attributes.caption: 主持人阐述她对表演的看法，认为其美妙之处在于彼此独立。

attributes.文字转写: And I'm sorry.
attributes.caption: 主持人简短地道歉。

attributes.文字转写: And Cotlin.
attributes.caption: 主持人提及一个名字“Cotlin”。

attributes.文字转写: He doesn't listen to you.
attributes.caption: 一位男演员用低沉的声音说：“他不听你的。”

attributes.文字转写: He just asks the same questions every week.
attributes.caption: 男演员继续抱怨对方每周都问同样的问题。

attributes.文字转写: How's your job?
attributes.caption: 男演员模仿提问：“你的工作怎么样？”

attributes.文字转写: Are you happy?
attributes.caption: 男演员继续模仿提问：“你开心吗？”

attributes.文字转写: But...
attributes.caption: 男演员犹豫地说：“但是……”

attributes.文字转写: Entonces quería matarlo, pero realmente no le guardo rencor.
attributes.嗓音声学细节: 声音带有颗粒感，略显疲惫
attributes.潜台词: 虽然有过极端想法，但已释怀
attributes.修辞策略: 对比（想杀人 vs 不记仇）
attributes.文化语境: 西班牙语文化背景下的个人情感表达
attributes.caption: 一名中年男演员用西班牙语平静地坦白，他曾想杀人，但现在已经不记仇了。

attributes.文字转写: There are no other fronts!
attributes.caption: 另一位男演员激动地喊道：“没有其他战线了！”

attributes.文字转写: This is the thing!
attributes.caption: 男演员继续激动地强调：“这就是关键！”

attributes.文字转写: He needs to know that I fought for him!
attributes.潜台词: 表达自己曾为对方而战，希望对方知晓这份付出
attributes.caption: 男演员激动地表示：“他需要知道我为他而战！”

attributes.文字转写: Face to face with the failure that is your career ain't worth crying about, madam.
attributes.caption: 又一位男演员冷静而尖锐地说：“面对你职业生涯的失败，哭泣是不值得的，女士。”

attributes.文字转写: Jesus built walls.
attributes.caption: 一位声音深沉的男演员庄重地说：“耶稣建造了墙壁。”

attributes.文字转写: His face is a face of mercy.
attributes.caption: 男演员继续阐述：“他的脸是仁慈的脸。”

attributes.文字转写: Mercy is the dynamite that blows down walls.
attributes.caption: 男演员用比喻总结道：“仁慈是炸毁墙壁的炸药。”

attributes.文字转写: It's happening to the easy version now.
attributes.caption: 一位女演员平静地说：“现在轮到简单的版本了。”

attributes.文字转写: Well, he's coming to terms with what it's like to be slightly more...
attributes.caption: 一位男演员开始解释，但话语在结尾处中断。

attributes.文字转写: Controla la emoción, no llores.
attributes.caption: 之前那位男演员用西班牙语命令道：“控制情绪，别哭。”

attributes.文字转写: No es mejor actor el que llora, sino el que lucha por contener las lágrimas.
attributes.caption: 男演员继续用西班牙语说教：“会哭的不是好演员，努力忍住眼泪的才是。”

attributes.文字转写: I don't know why everyone is so rude. I don't know why you are. I don't want anything from you. Maybe a little bit of warmth, maybe a hug, Dad.
attributes.caption: 一名年轻男子用激动且带哭腔的语气抱怨他人的粗鲁，并表达了对温暖和父爱的渴望。

attributes.文字转写: Well, every day I wake up and I hope you're dead.
attributes.caption: 一名中年男子愤怒地大喊，表示每天都希望对方死去。

attributes.文字转写: Dead like if I could guarantee that we would be okay, I'd hope you'd get an illness and then you'd get by a car and die.
attributes.caption: 该男子继续用愤怒的语气描述希望对方得病并被车撞死的场景。

attributes.文字转写: Make a ground to peace and remind you that truth may be blind to, but without love, it is unbearable.
attributes.caption: 一名声音沉稳的男子用缓慢的语速讲述关于和平、真理与爱的哲理。
现场观众爆发出热烈的掌声。

attributes.文字转写: Here are the nominees for performance by an actor in a leading role.
attributes.caption: 一位女主持人用正式的语气宣布最佳男主角提名名单。

attributes.文字转写: Antonio Banderas.
attributes.caption: 主持人宣布第一位提名者安东尼奥·班德拉斯。
现场观众为提名者鼓掌。

attributes.文字转写: Jodie Foster.
attributes.caption: 主持人宣布第二位提名者朱迪·福斯特。
现场观众为提名者鼓掌。

attributes.文字转写: Leonardo DiCaprio, Once Upon a Time in Hollywood.
attributes.命名实体: Leonardo DiCaprio, Once Upon a Time in Hollywood
attributes.重音与强调: Leonardo DiCaprio, Once Upon a Time in Hollywood
attributes.caption: 主持人宣布第三位提名者莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥及其作品《好莱坞往事》。
现场观众为提名者鼓掌。

attributes.文字转写: Adam Driver, Marriage Story.
attributes.caption: 主持人宣布第四位提名者亚当·德赖弗及其作品《婚姻故事》。
现场观众为提名者鼓掌。

attributes.文字转写: Joaquin Phoenix, Joker.
attributes.caption: 主持人宣布第五位提名者杰昆·菲尼克斯及其作品《小丑》。
现场观众为提名者鼓掌。

attributes.文字转写: And the Oscar goes to...
attributes.caption: 主持人用充满悬念的语气宣布奥斯卡奖即将揭晓。

attributes.文字转写: Joaquin Phoenix, Joker.
attributes.caption: 主持人兴奋地宣布杰昆·菲尼克斯凭借《小丑》获得奥斯卡奖。
现场观众为获奖者报以热烈的掌声。

attributes.文字转写: The first Oscar and fourth nomination for Joaquin Phoenix.
attributes.重音与强调: first Oscar, fourth nomination, Joaquin Phoenix
attributes.caption: 主持人补充说明这是杰昆·菲尼克斯的第一次获奖和第四次提名。

attributes.文字转写: God, I'm full of so much gratitude right now.
attributes.caption: 获奖者激动地表示此刻充满了感激之情。

attributes.文字转写: Uh, and I do not feel...
attributes.caption: 获奖者继续表达感受，但话语未完，情绪激动。

attributes.文字转写: elevated above any of my fellow nominees or anyone in this room because we share the same love, the love of film, and this form of expression has given me the most extraordinary life.
attributes.caption: 获奖者发表感言，表达对电影艺术的热爱和对 fellow nominees 的尊重。

attributes.文字转写: Um, I don't know what I'd be without it.
attributes.caption: 获奖者感慨如果没有电影，自己将不知如何是好。

attributes.文字转写: But I think the greatest gift that it's given me and many of us in this room is the opportunity to use our voice for the voiceless.
attributes.重音与强调: greatest gift, voice for the voiceless
attributes.caption: 获奖者指出电影给予他们最大的礼物是为无声者发声的机会。

attributes.文字转写: I've been thinking a lot about some of the distressing issues that we are facing collectively.
attributes.caption: 获奖者谈到他所思考的集体面临的令人不安的问题。

attributes.文字转写: And I think we feel or we're made to feel that we champion different causes.
attributes.潜台词: 人们认为我们立场不同
attributes.caption: 获奖者认为人们感觉或被告知他们支持不同的事业。

attributes.文字转写: But for me, I see commonality.
attributes.caption: 获奖者强调对他而言，看到的是共同点。

attributes.文字转写: I think whether we're talking about gender inequality or racism or queer rights or indigenous rights or animal rights, we're talking about the fight against injustice.
attributes.命名实体: gender inequality, racism, queer rights, indigenous rights, animal rights
attributes.潜台词: 所有正义斗争本质相同
attributes.caption: 获奖者列举多种社会议题，指出它们本质上都是对抗不公的斗争。

attributes.主旋律: 无明确主旋律
attributes.caption: 贯穿始终的柔和钢琴背景音乐，营造庄重感人的氛围。

attributes.文字转写: We're talking about the fight against the belief that one nation, one people, one race, one gender, or one species has the right to dominate, control, and use and exploit another with impunity.
attributes.停顿分布: 在列举项之间有短暂停顿
attributes.效价轨迹: 积极（就其倡导的价值观而言）
attributes.caption: 演讲者以激昂的语气阐述反对一种认为某一国家、人民、种族、性别或物种有权支配、控制和剥削他人的信念。
现场观众报以热烈的掌声。

attributes.文字转写: 嗯
attributes.caption: 演讲者在掌声后稍作停顿，发出一个填充词“嗯”。

attributes.文字转写: I think that we've become very disconnected from the natural world. And many of us, what we're guilty of is an egocentric worldview, the belief that we're the center of the universe. We go into the natural world and we plunder it for its resources. We feel entitled to artificially inseminate a cow. And when she gives birth, we steal her baby. Even though her cries of anguish are unmistakable. And then we take her milk that's intended for her calf, and we put it in our coffee and our cereal.
attributes.停顿分布: 在句子之间有逻辑停顿
attributes.说话人意图: 批判人类中心主义，唤起同情
attributes.潜台词: 人类对自然和动物造成了巨大伤害
attributes.caption: 演讲者继续阐述，认为人类与自然脱节，持有以自我为中心的世界观，并列举了掠夺资源、人工授精、偷走牛犊、窃取牛奶等例子来批判人类对动物的残忍。

attributes.文字转写: And I think we fear the idea of personal change because we think that we have to sacrifice something to give something up.
attributes.说话人意图: 分析人们抗拒改变的心理
attributes.潜台词: 改变需要付出代价，这是人们恐惧的原因
attributes.caption: 演讲者最后总结，认为人们之所以害怕个人改变，是因为他们认为必须牺牲一些东西才能放弃另一些东西。

attributes.文字转写: But human beings at our best are so inventive and creative and ingenious. And I think that when we use love and compassion as our guiding principles, we can create, develop and implement systems of change that are beneficial to all sentient beings and to the environment.
attributes.重音与强调: best, inventive, creative, ingenious, love, compassion
attributes.潜台词: 表达对人性的乐观看法
attributes.caption: 演讲者以充满希望和真诚的语气，阐述了人类在最佳状态下所具备的创造力，并强调以爱与同情为准则可以建立有益的系统。

attributes.文字转写: I've been selfish, I've been cruel at times, hard to work with, and ungrateful. But so many of you in this room have given me a second chance.
attributes.潜台词: 承认自己的不足并感谢他人的包容
attributes.caption: 演讲者坦承自己曾自私、残忍且不知感恩，但感谢在场许多人给予他第二次机会，语气谦逊而真诚。

attributes.文字转写: And I think that's when we're at our best, when when we support each other, cancel each other out for past mistakes, but when we help each other to grow, when we educate each other, when we guide each other towards redemption. That is the best of humanity.
attributes.重音与强调: best, support, grow, educate, guide, redemption, best of humanity
attributes.caption: 演讲者情绪达到高潮，通过排比句式强调相互支持、帮助成长和引导救赎才是人性的最佳体现。
演讲结束后，现场爆发出热烈的掌声，表示对演讲者的认可与赞赏。

attributes.文字转写: I just, I want to, um, when he, when he was, when he was, when he was 17, my brother wrote this lyric.
attributes.不流畅类型: 填充词 (um), 重复 (when he was)
attributes.潜台词: 表达对兄弟的怀念与感激
attributes.caption: 在掌声中，演讲者情绪激动，略带哽咽地开始分享一个关于他17岁时兄弟写下歌词的个人故事。

attributes.文字转写: He said run to the rescue with love and peace will follow. Thank you.
attributes.caption: 演讲者引用了一句歌词作为结尾，并真诚地感谢观众。
热烈的掌声

attributes.文字转写: Here are the nominees for performance by an actress in a leading role.
attributes.caption: 主持人宣布最佳女主角提名名单

attributes.文字转写: Cynthia Erivo, Harriet.
attributes.caption: 宣布第一位提名者：辛西娅·艾莉沃，电影《哈丽特》
热烈的掌声

attributes.文字转写: Scarlett Johansson, Marriage Story.
attributes.caption: 宣布第二位提名者：斯嘉丽·约翰逊，电影《婚姻故事》
热烈的掌声

attributes.文字转写: Saoirse Ronan, Little Women.
